# 太清經天師口訣-六朝

**ID:** KR5c0281
**Custom ID:** ZB5c0272

**Editions:** SJB, ZHDZ

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Oral Instructions of the Celestial Master on the Great-Clarity Scripture*

Anonymous; Six Dynasties

A Six-Dynasties Daoist alchemical **oral-instruction text** (*kǒu jué* 口訣) purporting to transmit the Celestial Master's (*Tiān shī* 天師, i.e., [張道陵](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BC%B5%E9%81%93%E9%99%B5)) secret commentary on the **Tài qīng** 太清 alchemical scripture corpus. Preserved as **DZ 883** / CT 883 (*Dòngshén bù, Zhòng shù lèi* 洞神部眾術類).

**Dating.** Six Dynasties. Dynasty: 六朝.
